bullets.text: Zero-Waste Connectivity Solution - **RETN** launches Flex IX, combining Remote IX and IP Transit to eliminate unused bandwidth.
FCC Targets Hong Kong Telecom - **HKT** faces potential service revocation in the U.S. amid national security concerns.
AT&T's Steady Growth - **AT&T** reports Q3 revenue of $30.7B, driven by fiber expansion and 5G deployment.
Private 5G Revolution - Organizations are increasingly adopting private 5G for enhanced connectivity in mission-critical operations.
T-Mobile's Hybrid 5G Strategy - **T-Mobile US** launches Edge Control, offering enterprise-grade performance with reduced costs.
Amigo Mesh Network for Protesters - New mesh network aims to keep political protesters connected during internet blackouts.
Wi-Fi 8 for Device Density - Upcoming **Wi-Fi 8** standard set to tackle the explosion of connected devices.
Vodafone's AI Network Management - **Vodafone** partners with Zinkworks to automate 5G operations using AI technology.
PSTN Switch-Off Deadline Approaches - UK businesses must prepare for the PSTN switch-off by January 2027.
Vodafone's Black Sea Cable Project - **Vodafone Group** plans a new submarine cable to enhance connectivity in the Black Sea region.
